sources.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
sources.snippet: Motivated by this finding, we introduce OPD-V, a visual OPSD paradigm that instantiates such information through the Positive Teacher and Negative Teacher. Positive Modality-Balance Logits Margins define a Modality-Balance Trust Region that selects the on-policy tokens used for self-distillation.

sources.title: [2609.39692] GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of ...
sources.snippet: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale.
